'''Leesub Sirln''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Qiraash/Legends|Qiraash]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who demonstrated limited powers of precognition. She was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] as a [[Youngling/Legends|child]] before being discovered by [[High Inquisitor]] [[Antinnis Tremayne]], who selected her as a [[Force Adept]]. She escaped Tremayne and hid in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where she was seen lurking in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and talking to [[Ownellco/Legends|Ownellco]].

==Behind the scenes==
Leesub Sirln was played by actress [[Pam Rose]].<ref name="Insider 154">{{InsiderCite|154|Bounty Hunters}}</ref> The character was first named through the [[Decipher]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].
